title: Derinkuyu underground city found by a man renovating his home

tellings.quote: he's he's basically working on his apartment and he knocks a wall down accidentally and he opens up this doorway opening

plain: Derinkuyu, a vast underground city in Turkey, was found when a man fixing up his home knocked down a wall by accident and opened a doorway into it. The researcher Matt LaCroix tells this without naming a source. He tells it as an example of how much of the deep past may still lie hidden.
